observations: Three photos show a large blue industrial gear reducer with a yellow output shaft.
The unit has a flanged input side, a flanged output side, and a flat base plate with bolt holes.
The casing is painted blue, with visible casting ribs and bolts securing the casing to the base.
The yellow shaft is attached to the output side, with a hexagonal flange.
No visible brand name, model number, or rating plate is readable on the unit in any photo.
The unit appears to be made of cast iron or steel, consistent with 'cast bodies types'.
The photos are taken outdoors on a paved surface with a brick wall in the background.
Watermark 'IFABROS INDUSTRIAL POSTED ON JIJI' is present on all photos.

claims.claim: Gear reducer 15 to 20hp cast bodies types
claims.evidence: No horsepower rating or model number is visible in any photo. The 'cast bodies types' is plausible but not verifiable from the images.

claims.claim: Tokunbo, direct from Belgium. Tested and working, no knock, low mileage, never opened.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The gear reducer may not be 15-20hp as claimed.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the nameplate or rating plate showing the horsepower rating.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a generic cast gear reducer without horsepower specification, which may be lower than 15-20hp.

risks.risk: The unit may be damaged or worn, especially at the shaft or bearings, which are not visible in the photos.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the shaft, bearings, and internal gears, or a video showing rotation.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially non-functional or requiring repair.

risks.risk: The unit may be missing parts or have missing bolts or mounting hardware.
risks.proof: A full 360-degree photo or video showing all sides, bolts, and mounting points.
risks.if_unproven: priced as possibly incomplete or requiring additional parts.

proof_requests: Close-up of the rating plate showing the horsepower and model number.
Close-up photo of the nameplate or rating plate.
Close-up photo of the shaft, bearings, and internal gears.
Full 360-degree photo or video showing all sides and mounting points.
Photo of the back or side showing any missing parts or damage.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
